body: config.key (derived from the name if unset: planus-manus → PM), ticket.number allocated as max+1 under a lock (parallel creates unique), KEY-n accepted by tickets.get/update/move/readiness, comments, relations, context, CLI and search (exact key ranks first). pman keys init numbers existing tickets by creation time; pman keys renumber fixes duplicates; validate warns about duplicates and unnumbered tickets. This project now uses PM-1…PM-80.
